name: lui
description: lui — 不写 Pascal 的声明式 GUI 应用框架（XML + CSS + TS，单二进制运行时：开发/运行/构建/交付）

scripts.test: node scripts/build.js test && node scripts/build.js renderer && node scripts/verify-baseline.js
scripts.render:gallery: bin\lui-render.exe demo/ui_gallery.xml -o bin/gallery_light.png -w 560 -H 980 -t light && bin\lui-render.exe demo/ui_gallery.xml -o bin/gallery_dark.png -w 560 -H 980 -t dark
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['bin', 'tools/renderer/lib', 'tools/renderer/lib-single', 'tools/renderer/embedded', 'tests/lib', 'demo/lib'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); }); console.log('清理完毕');"

author: issueye
